It was originally constructed for the 1976 Olympic Games as a velodrome and hosted both track cycling and judo events. After renovations began in 1989, it opened in 1992 as an indoor nature exhibit featuring replicas of four ecosystems found in the Americas. The building is part of the Space for Life natural science museum complex, which includes the Montreal Insectarium, Montreal Botanical Garden, and Rio Tinto Alcan Planetarium.
